parameters.query:
WITH attempted AS (
  INSERT INTO routing_decisions (
    routing_id, event_id, routing_method, intent, selected_domains,
    excluded_domains, dependencies, policy_version, decision_status
  )
  VALUES (
    $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3, $4, $5::jsonb,
    $6::jsonb, $7::jsonb, $8, $9
  )
  ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING routing_id, event_id, decision_status, created_at
),
resolved AS (
  SELECT routing_id, event_id, decision_status, created_at, true AS is_new
  FROM attempted
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.routing_id, r.event_id, r.decision_status, r.created_at, false AS is_new
  FROM routing_decisions r
  WHERE r.event_id = $2::uuid
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attempted)
  LIMIT 1
),
audit_entry AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (
    tenant_id, correlation_id, actor, actor_role, action, object_type,
    object_id, outcome, release_id, event_hash, previous_event_hash
  )
  SELECT
    $10, $11::uuid, 'n8n:wf-03', 'ROUTING',
    CASE WHEN x.is_new THEN 'ROUTING_REGISTERED' ELSE 'ROUTING_DUPLICATE_IGNORED' END,
    'ROUTING_DECISION', x.routing_id::text,
    CASE WHEN x.is_new THEN x.decision_status ELSE 'DUPLICATE_IGNORED' END,
    $12, $13, NULL
  FROM resolved x
  RETURNING audit_id
)
SELECT
  x.routing_id, x.event_id, x.decision_status, x.created_at, x.is_new,
  CASE WHEN x.is_new THEN 'ROUTING_REGISTERED' ELSE 'DUPLICATE_IGNORED' END AS registration_status,
  (SELECT audit_id FROM audit_entry LIMIT 1) AS audit_id,
  $14::jsonb AS envelope
FROM resolved x;
